segments.he: וזה שמסיימתהמגילה דורש טובלעמו ודובר שלום לכל זרעו. דורש טוב לעמו זה בחי' דרשות התורה שזכה מרדכי שהי' פותח בדברים ודורשן שעי"ז הי' יכול לקרב נפשות להש"י וזהו דורש טוב לעמו הם עם בני ישראל שכולם מושרשין באותות התורה שהי' מרדכי מאיר בהם הארה בכל פעם משרשי אותיות התורה שדרש בהם שעי"ז עוררם לתשובה בכל פעם וכנ"ל ועי"ז נתרומם הכבוד דקדושה לשרשו ועי"ז נמשך שלום כ"ש בהתורה הנ"ל שמתחלת להמשיך שלום בעולם וזוה ודובר שלום לכל זרעו כי עי"ז נמשך שלום כנ"ל וזהו לכל זרעו כי זוכה שהיי' נמשך השלום לכל זרעו שהמשיך נשמות בהירות וזכות לזרעו ע"י שהאיר שרשי אותיות התורה וכנ"ל ואזי השלום הנמשך עי"ז בוודאי נמשך ביותר לזרעו שנמשכו לזה העולם עי"ז וזהו ודובר שלום לכל זרעו בחי' וכל בניך לימודי ה' ורב שלום בניך כי כשהת"ח זוכים לבנים ת"ח על ידי שמברכין בתורה תחילה בחינו תמרדכי שהי' פותח בדברים ודורשין על ידי זה ורב שלום בניך כי עי"ז ממשיך שלום כנ"ל:
segments.en:
of mishpat in its fullness, having given us the Torah which is

the aspect of mishpat as above, and at the giving of the Torah

— when Israel drew close to their Father in Heaven, which is the aspect of

gairim and baalai teshuvah

— he then merited to arouse the angels of the heart, the fire of judgment above, in

its fullness. And in truth he succeeded, for he merited to subdue the evil entirely, for

Israel who stood at Mount Sinai — their filth ceased. For all the evil was entirely

nullified through the fire of judgment above, as above. And yet afterwards the

Erev Rav corrupted things, until the Holy Blessed One said

“Go down,” etc. — because they are in the aspect of the wicked whom it

is forbidden to bring close, for the mishpat cannot avail

against them as above. All the more so ordinary people who certainly cannot rely on their

own mishpat alone, but must judge themselves greatly

regarding everything in order to arouse the blazing of the heart. And afterwards surrender

the mishpat to the Blessed One in the aspect of

“for judgment belongs to God,”

so that the Blessed One Himself give them wisdom and knowledge to weigh their words in

judgment, and merit to know how to speak with, and how not to speak with, and how to speak,

and when to speak, and in what manner and what and how much — for it is impossible for

a person to calibrate this judgment well as above, particularly now in this exile. And the

exile is like night, when only the mishpat must be surrendered

to the Blessed One as above. For now in this exile, particularly in

ikv’ah d’meshicha [the footsteps of Mashiach],

Moshe Rabbeinu himself is compelled to clothe himself within all of Israel and to reincarnate

with them in order to rectify the blemish he caused in judgment by bringing the

Erev Rav close, as cited in the

Tikunim and the holy Zohar in many places. It is thus found

that now in the power of Moshe Rabbeinu we must rectify the blemish of the

mishpat that was blemished through the

Erev Rav. And because of this the

mishpat is exceedingly wondrous, hidden, and concealed —

for even Moshe Rabbeinu descended from his level through the

Erev Rav whom he brought close, as is known. And therefore it

is said about Israel in this exile: “she has gone down

wondrously”. And the ketz [end] is wondrous,

hidden, and exceedingly concealed, as it is written:

“how long until the wondrous end?”

[Daniel 12:6]. And all of this is because of the wonders

and the concealment of the mishpat that must rectify the

blemish of the mishpat that occurred through the

Erev Rav — this mishpat

being wondrous and exceedingly concealed, in the aspect of

segments.he: אות יט
segments.en:
“if a matter of judgment is wondrous for

you” [Devarim 17:8]. And one must only

judge oneself well, and afterwards surrender the mishpat to

the Blessed One alone, in the aspect of “for judgment

belongs to God,” as above.

For there are two aspects of mishpat. The first is what a

person must do: to judge himself every day — that is, to seclude himself with his

Creator and to pour out his conversation before Him, and to lay bare all that is in his

heart before the Blessed One, and to think through his ways and to judge himself in all

his paths — whether it is proper for him to spend his days thus, God forbid, in ways

such as these, etc. And the second aspect of mishpat is to

weigh one’s words with judgment — that is, to know how to speak and with whom

to speak and to draw one’s wisdom into them, etc. And this is hinted at in the words

of our Rabbeinu, in the teaching above, where these two aspects are mentioned, as is

explained there. And the fire of the angel is made from the first aspect: weighing one’s

words with judgment — and the person judges himself, etc. — and they are two

aspects. Weighing one’s words, etc., is one aspect; the person judging himself is the

second aspect. And at the end of the teaching this is explained more clearly, as it is written

there: for through weighing one’s words in judgment, one thereby can teach one’s

wisdom to students, etc. — see there.

Now, judging oneself — this every person can fulfill, as above. But the second aspect

— weighing one’s words with judgment as above — this requires great

assistance from Above, that one merit this knowledge. And furthermore, even afterwards one

cannot rely on one’s own wisdom and judgment alone, for there are wicked ones in the

aspect of the Erev Rav — for whose sake the judgment

is exalted beyond them — who are the primary cause of the length of the exile, as is

known. And therefore one must surrender this mishpat to the

Blessed One — and the Blessed One knows the hidden things, and will lead him in the

straight path, so that he merits to calibrate the judgment well: to know with whom to speak,

etc. And to recognize the wicked who must not be brought close, so that he not bring them

close at all. And then when the mishpat is rectified, the

Bais ha-Mikdash shall be built, which is the aspect of the

Haichal ha-Kodesh, as above. And it shall be fulfilled:

“as in the days of your coming out of Egypt, I shall

show you wonders” [Michah 7:15] —

this being the rectification of the wonder of the mishpat,

the aspect of “if a matter of judgment is wondrous for

you,” through which the ketz ha-p’laos

[the wondrous end] is concealed. And may the Blessed One have mercy upon us and show us

the wonders of the mishpat, and then shall be fulfilled:

“Tzion shall be redeemed through mishpat, and her

segments.he: וזה בחי' מה שאמר אדמו"ר ז"ל שפורים מרומז בסוד הפסוק "ואם "מפאת "פניו "ימרט "ראשו וכו' שהוא ר"ת פורי"ם כי פסוק זה מדבר מבחי' נגעים ונגעים באים על גסות הרוח כשפרש"י בפ' מצורע ע"פ ועץ ארז ואיזוב ושני תולעת שזהו בחינות פורים כי כל בחי' פורים הוא להכניע קליפת המן עמלק שהוא בחי' גאות וגסות כנ". וזהו בחי' ד' מראות נגעים כנגד ד' בחינות שפלות הנ"ל שהם מכיניען ומתקנין בחי' ד' מראות נגעים שבאים על גסות כנ"ל:
segments.en:
returnees through tzedakah” [Yeshayahu 1:27]

— speedily in our days, Amen and Amen.

((Belongs to the above.))

For this reason specifically Yisro merited to give counsel to Moshe Rabbeinu regarding the

matter of judgment, as it is written:

“but you shall look out from among all the

people” [Sh’mos 18:21], etc.

For Yisro, who is a ger tzedek, whose primary drawing close

to the Blessed One was through mishpat as above —

therefore he merited to add to the Torah the section of mishpat,

which is the passage beginning “and you shall look

out”, as above. And therefore the section of the giving of the Torah is

juxtaposed to the section of mishpat — for the fire

of the giving of the Torah is the aspect of the fire of judgment above, for Israel drew

close then to the Blessed One.

And this is the aspect of tekiah-sh’varim-teruah, which

are the aspects of the three Patriarchs, as is cited. For the Patriarchs would convert

gairim, as explained in the teaching above. This is

accomplished through the shofar, which is the aspect of

yirah and mishpat as above,

as it is written: “from Heaven You caused judgment to

be heard; the earth feared and was still”

[Tehillim 76:9]. And this is the aspect of

Malchuyos, Zichronos, and

Shofros.

Malchuyos — this is the aspect of

shem above, the aspect of the

Haichal ha-Kodesh, etc., above. For

shem is the aspect of Malchus

as above, as we say in Malchuyos:

“and God shall be King over all the earth; on that day

God shall be One and His name One”

[Z’charyah 14:9].

Zichronos — this is the aspect of

mishpat above, that a person judges himself, through which

the judgment above is sweetened. For the entire blessing of

“You remember the deeds of the world”

speaks of judgment, as it is written:

“You remember the deeds of the world and take note”,

etc. — who is not reckoned on this day, etc. — which is the aspect of

mishpat: that a person must think through his ways, etc.,

knowing that the Blessed One remembers all and nothing is forgotten before Him, and all his

לתורהו עבודה כנ"ל אבל תיכף כשמתגאה ותזוח דעתו עליו אומרים לו יתוש קדמך כי אז הוא רדןוי לפניהם לפני כל בהמה וחי' ועוף כשארז"ל זכה רודה בהם לא זכה נעשה ירוד לפניהם וכן הוא בכל אדם גם עתה שיש שהש"י נותן לאדם עשירות וחפצים הרבה בהמות ועופות ותבואה ופירות ומלבושים וכו' כאלו הכל נברא בשבילו. ובאמת הוא כן כי הכל נברא בשבילו כדי שיכנוס לסעודה וכו' היינו כדי שיעסוק בעבודת ה' ועי"ז יזכה לסעודה המעותדת לצדיקים וכו'. אבלכל אחד לפי בחינתו א"א לזכות לזה כ"א ע"י שפלות באמת כנ"ל. ותיכף כשמתגאה ודעתו זחה עליו מורידין אותו ואומרים לו יתוש קדמך וכנ"ל. נמצא שעיקר בריאת האדם אחר כל בהמה וכו' הוא בשביל שפלות כדי שיזכה עי"ז לתורה. וזה שרמזה התורה בפ' תזריע שהזכירה תות האדם כשנולד שהוא בחי' בריאת האדם שנולד ונברא ויוצא אדם חדש לעולם והזכירה אותו בסוף אחר כל בהמה חיה ועוף לומר כשם שיצירתו אחר כל בהמה חי' ועוף שהוא בשביל שיזכור שפלותו כך תורתו נתפרשה אחר כל בהמה חי' ועוף כי הם בחי' אחת כי מה שנברא בסוף זהו בעצמו ג"כ בשביל זה כדי שיזכה לתורה ע"י השפלות ע"י שנברא באחרונ. וע"כ נתפרשה תורתו בסוף כמו יצירתו כי הכל בחי' אחת כי גם יצירתו בסוף הי' בשביל התורה כי א"א לזכות לתורה כ"א ע"י ענוה ושפלות שבשביל זה נברא האדם באחרונה וכנ"ל. וזהו שנסמך לזה הלכות נגעים שבאין על גסות וכנ"ל:
segments.en:

always judge himself as above.

Shofros — this is the aspect of the fire of judgment

above, the aspect of “the voice of God hews flames of

fire,” as above, as is cited in this blessing:

“and all the people saw the thunderings and the

torches,” etc. — as above. For through all these aspects,

gairim and baalai teshuvah are

brought close to the Blessed One — which is the primary aspect of

Rosh Hashanah, as above.

And this is the aspect of the shamash [sexton] striking with

a hammer in the morning to wake the world to go to the bais

knesses [synagogue]. For in the morning the mishpat

is aroused, as above — for then the judgment goes out to light, as above, in the

aspect of “judge judgment in the morning,”

as above. And this is the aspect of the striking with a hammer — for striking is the

aspect of din and mishpat,

namely the fire of judgment above, in the aspect of:

“Is not My word like fire… and like a

hammer” [Yirmiyahu 23:29] — for

through the fire of judgment in the aspect of striking, all the distant ones are brought

close to His service. And therefore the world is awoken through this striking to go to the

bais knesses, which is the gathering place of all —

that all of them draw close to the Blessed One and go to the

bais knesses to engage in the service of God. For through the

fire of judgment, the aspect of striking, which burns all the evil from the

Haichal ha-Kodesh — through this all of them can draw

close to the Blessed One and go to the bais knesses, which

is the aspect of the Haichal ha-Kodesh. Also, the sound of

the striking is a strong voice, the aspect of the voice that arouses the

mishpat as above — for the primary arousal of

mishpat is through the voice, which is the aspect of the

voice of the shofar as above, for voice is the aspect of

mishpat, as is known. And therefore all the plagues and

judgments that Moshe executed in Egypt were through striking with the staff, for striking

is the aspect of mishpat as above. And therefore three strikes

are made in the morning — this being the aspect of mishpat

which is in three, as above. And therefore on Shabbos there is no waking for the

bais knesses through striking with a hammer, for on Shabbos

there is no need to arouse mishpat, for on Shabbos the evil

is nullified, for then the Shechinah rests, etc., as above.

And this is why the blessing “restore our judges”

segments.he: וזהו שאמר שם אדמו"ר ז"ל שפורים הוא תיקון חטא קרח שמרומז בפסוק ואם מפאת פניו הנ"ל. כי כל פגם קרח הי' מחלוקת שחלק על הצדיק האמ תשהוא משה ע"י גסות רוחו וגאותו שארז"ל. וע"כ התיקון בפורים שאז מכנייען קליפת המן עמלק שהוא הגאות. ועי"ז נתבטל המחלוקת ונמשך שלום. בחי' ודובר שלום לכל זרעו שמסיימת המגילה בזה. כי זה עיקר התיקון וכנ"ל:
segments.en:
is juxtaposed to the blessing “who gathers the

scattered”, etc. — for this gathering is the aspect of

baalai teshuvah and gairim

who were initially scattered and distant from holiness and are now gathered and drawn close

to the Blessed One, and all the scattered and dispersed holy sparks ascend. And therefore

next to this is juxtaposed “restore our judges”

— for for this, mishpat is needed, as above.

And this is why after the blessing of mishpat the blessing

of the heretics is juxtaposed: “and for the informers

let there be no hope”, etc. — this being the aspect of the wicked

ones who must not be brought close, against whom the mishpat

does not avail, as above. We request that they have no hope and perish and be uprooted and

nullified and cause us no harm at all. And then the horn of the

tzaddikim and the chasidim

shall be exalted — for once one merits to distance the wicked ones against whom the

mishpat does not avail, then the

mishpat shall be in its proper place, and then the

gairim shall not be able, God forbid, to sway the hearts of

the tzaddikim from the Blessed One. And therefore through

this there shall be a “support and security for the

righteous,” and then when the tzaddikim

merit the mishpat in its fullness, the

Haichal ha-Kodesh shall be built, as above — which is

the aspect of the building of Yerushalayim, as above. And then there shall be the sprouting

of the horn of David, which is the aspect of the kisai ha-mishpat

above, the aspect of Malchus as above — the aspect of

the kingship of David, of whom it is said:

“and his throne as the days of heaven”

[Tehillim 89:30], and as it is written:

“and his throne shall be established in kindness, and

one who sits upon it in truth in the tent of David, judging and seeking

judgment” [Yeshayahu 16:5]. And it is

written of him: “and he shall not judge by the sight of

his eyes”, etc., and “he shall judge

the poor with righteousness”

[Yeshayahu 11:3–4]. For the primary sprouting of

the horn of Mashiach is through the rectification of mishpat

— through which Yerushalayim the Holy City shall be built, which is the aspect of

the Haichal ha-Kodesh, as above. And therefore all these

blessings are juxtaposed to one another.
